resources.string: Give the month as a whole, or an expense category, a monthly limit, and this screen shows how close the month is to it.
A budget can be on all your spending, or on an expense category, which you create in Settings › Categories.
What counts is what went out this month, in all or of each category, plus the subscriptions still due before the month ends. Amber from 80 %% of the limit, red once it is over.
%1$s spent and about %2$s to come, of %3$s
Every expense of the month, with a category or without
All spending can have one budget, and each expense category one more.
To move this limit to another category, delete it and set a new one.
All spending and every expense category already have a budget.
That could not be saved. Its category may have been deleted meanwhile.
The limit goes. Nothing you have recorded changes.
